history.text: Brazil accepts the current public package: attributed consultation summaries and a consolidated note. This format is within our fictional mandate and leaves official mandate and review deadlines untouched.

Japan accepts the current package: attributed consultation summaries and a consolidated note. This format is within our fictional mandate and leaves the official mandate and review deadlines untouched.

Every available package has a checked rejection in the public record: closed by FRA, aggregate by GBR, public by GHA, and hybrid by ARE. No package remains acceptable to every participant, so the workshop records an impasse. The official mandate and review deadlines remain untouched.

options.public: Publish attributed consultation summaries and a consolidated note.
options.aggregate: Publish only a consolidated note with no attributed submissions.
options.hybrid: Publish a consolidated note and send an attributed annex to the consultation participants only.
options.closed: Send attributed summaries to participants only and publish no consolidated note.
